canonical_signed_cell_logic: Build orientation descriptors only from ties or near-ties that can change canonical_top20(G0,tau) final membership or position.
For each compatible cell store final_top20_rankings, full_outsider_order_for_enumeration, signed_gap_edges, cell_sha256, and top20_sha256 as separate hash-bound objects.
Every required internal top20 edge and every 20th-vs-all-outsiders edge is enforced as G[q,a]-G[q,b] >= tau+eta.
Internal top20 ties are not retained as tie groups in v7; they are oriented into strict signed gaps.
Reject duplicate IDs, cycles, unresolved tie maps, incomplete adjacent enumeration, orientation rank over 8, pivot count over 32, and any full-ranking-to-top20 acceptance check.
phase_i_acceptance: Use the exact actual oriented v5 fixture and the complete frozen 589 original residual map.
Keep the additive signed-gap map separate from the original 589 residual map.

Accept a cell only if max original residual <= 1e-8, PSD is positive full-rank, signed gaps pass, canonical_top20(G,tau) exactly equals the stored final top20, hashes bind, and independent replay agrees.
Remove an incompatible cell only with a replayed logical contradiction or replayed conic/Farkas certificate; no witness or nonconvergence is not infeasibility.
phase_ii_certificate_scheme: Optimize the original frozen Gram displacement plus original slack objective over direct Gram upper triangle and xi.
Use all 589 original constraints, additive signed gaps, SOC trust constraints, and PSD.
SciPy may search primals, but acceptance requires solver-independent replay.
Reconstruct equality/free duals, nonnegative linear multipliers, Lorentz-cone SOC duals, and a PSD dual matrix S.
If PSD is inactive, certify S=0 and a positive eig margin; if active, certify S, SG, trace(SG), and PSD dual feasibility.
Replay recomputes objective, all 589 residuals, signed gaps, canonical top20, orientation completeness, hashes, stationarity, dual feasibility, VI, PSD/SOC/linear duals, and complementarity.
execution_order: Submit static validator through SLURM with conda HateVideo, CPU-only, no --time.
Only if the validator naturally completes and machine gate is OK, submit the actual certificate job through SLURM.
After natural terminal certificate job, submit independent replay as a separate SLURM job.
Record every v7 job, natural state, exit, resources, hashes, and failures.
nonclaims: No G0 PASS or freeze claim.
No formal gate, G1, realfold, performance, validation, test, teacher, MLLM, OCR, or segment-level claim.
Terminal outcome may only request a fresh result-to-claim review or route pivot.
